description: Send a WeChat customer service message from the brand’s Service Account to ONE person: text, or one picture (PNG, JPEG or GIF, up to 10 MB; anything else is refused with the reason). A text and a picture are two messages. THE RULE THAT NEVER GOES AWAY: WeChat accepts at most 5 messages in the 48 hours after the person’s LAST message to the account, and none once that has passed or the 5 are used, until they write again. A send outside that is refused here for free, in a sentence, before WeChat is asked, and read_wechat_inbox shows repliesLeft for every conversation. There are NO broadcasts and NO articles: never offer to post to WeChat or to message people who have not written. THIS REACHES A REAL PERSON, so it is confirm-gated: show the user the exact message, get an explicit yes, then call again with confirm:true. WeChat gives no message id and no way to read a sent message back, so the answer is WeChat’s own acceptance. Free: neither WeChat nor Hermoso charges for it. 0 credits.

confirm.description: REQUIRED true: this sends a real message to a real person

imageUrl.description: one picture, PNG, JPEG or GIF up to 10 MB, instead of text: a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

to.description: the person’s OpenID, shown on every conversation in read_wechat_inbox
